newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Travel Services HK closes US$150 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: China Travel Services HK closes US$150 mln FRN.

text.p: China Travel Services Holding Hong Kong's US$150 million floating rate note issue has been allotted, bankers said.
The five-year facility was priced at par to float at 110 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
Fees are 35 basis points split as 15 basis points for management and underwriting and 20 basis points for selling.
LTCB International and Sanwa International PLC are lead managers with US$42 million each.
Daiwa Europe, Deutsche Bank Singapore and Standard Chartered Bank are co-lead managers with US$10 million each.
BA Asia, Baring Brothers, Midland Bank, Nippon Credit International Hong Kong, Sakura Finance Asia and Societe Generale Asia are co-managers with US$5 million each.
Banque Nationale de Paris and BT Asia are co-managers with US$3 million each
China Travel Services Holdings is the parent of China Travel International Investment Hong Kong.
